buffalo.name: Buffalo
buffalo.description: Strong and nature-bound, Buffalo will do whatever it takes to protect their land.

caribou.name: Caribou
caribou.description: Not even the bitter cold can stop the Caribou from thriving, protected by the souls of their ancestors which dance in the polar sky.

cattle.name: Cattle
cattle.description: Worshippers of the sacred soil and waters, even a desert can turn lush under the hooves of the Cattle.

changeling.name: Changeling
changeling.description: With strong illusion magic, Changelings wander from their hives and among society and no secrets can be kept from them.

deer.name: Deer
deer.description: Perfectly attuned to nature, Deer can hold down even an industralized army with just what the forest provides.

donkey.name: Donkey
donkey.description: Hard-working and religious, Donkeys toil away in farms and workshops.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: With breath of fire that melts even the hardest metals, tools forged by Dragons last as long as the universe itself.

earthPony.name: Earth Pony
earthPony.description: Earth Ponies are the masters of infrastructure and their cities are well oiled machines capable of producing wealth beyond belief.

griffon.name: Griffon
griffon.description: Tough and ingenious, Griffons make up for the lack of resources of their land with inventions that amaze and astonish all other creatures.

kirin.name: Kirin
kirin.description: Commanding powerful fire magic, an army of Kirins can stand tall against even mighty Dragons.

lamia.name: Lamia
lamia.description: Defended by strong mind magic, any army that tries to conquer the lamias will find itself turning around for reasons unknown.

llama.name: Llama
llama.description: Llamas thrive among mountain peaks in altitudes that even Pegasi struggle to breathe in.

pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.description: The pegasi rule the skies and can alter the weather to what convenes them, wrecking aerial devastation on their enemies.

seapony.name: Seapony
seapony.description: Seaponies are unrivaled in the endless expanse of the seas and are no match for any navy.

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.description: The knowledge of geometry and architecture of the Sphinxes make them a must-have for the construction of any monument.

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.description: Unicorns possess a knowledge of magic that no species can rival and their wizards are prepared for any possible threat.

yak.name: Yak
yak.description: Perhaps the strongest ungulate that exists, Yaks can smash through rocks and fear not the wrath of the earth.

zebra.name: Zebra
zebra.description: With knowledge of botany and alchemy, there is no disease that can't be cured by the zebras.
